name: Manifold Voxel Repair
definition: Adds voxels to a set until no two voxels touch along an edge or at a corner alone, ensuring the resulting mesh is manifold (watertight). It resolves non-manifold contacts by filling empty cells between touching voxels.
summary: Manifold Voxel Repair is a post-processing step that resolves non-manifold contacts in existing voxel sets by filling empty cells to ensure watertightness, distinguishing itself by operating on pre-existing data rather than generation.
